negative_rules.reason: Composite risk or hazard conclusions are hazard estimators, not criterion observations.
Actions and tooling belong to action/readiness layers, not sustainability or technical hazard criteria.
A URL may point to restricted documentation. URL presence can at most infer partial_specification.

negative_rules.reject_when: source_type contains nara and from_field contains *
negative_rules.reason: NARA rubric questions must be reviewed one-by-one.

negative_rules.reject_when: review_status == approved or decided_by is not null
negative_rules.reason: AI may draft mappings only; approved mappings require human decided_by.
